question: The Purandaradasa Aradhana is principally a ________ Festival.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Classical Music**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Purandaradasa was a renowned 16th-century Carnatic music composer and saint.
 
• He is revered as the "**Pitamaha**" (grandfather) of Carnatic music for his significant contributions to its development and systematization.
 
• The Purandaradasa Aradhana is an annual festival held in his honor, primarily in Hampi, Karnataka, where he lived and attained Samadhi.
 
• The festival is observed on **Pushya Bahula Amavasya day**, the new moon day in the Pushya month of the Indian lunar calendar, which usually falls in February or March.
 
• During the Aradhana, numerous Carnatic music concerts are held, featuring performances by renowned musicians.
 
• These concerts showcase the rich heritage of Carnatic music and pay homage to Purandaradasa's invaluable contributions to this art form.
 
• The festival attracts a large number of music enthusiasts and devotees from across India and beyond, making it a significant cultural event in Karnataka.
 
• The Purandaradasa Aradhana serves as a platform for the appreciation and propagation of Carnatic music, keeping alive the legacy of this legendary composer and saint.
